title: Spend rules
text: 16 rules for caps, recipients, price changes, replays and wrong chains. Tested.

title: Token rules, in the same answer
text: 9 rules on the token being bought: mint with a live owner, blacklist, pause, upgradeable proxy, ticker copies, low liquidity. Tested; live on the hosted gate, unknown tokens read straight from the chain.

title: Hash-chained audit log
text: Every decision is recorded. Editing an old line breaks the chain and is caught.

title: CLI, MCP server and signer wrapper
text: Run from source today. Only the signer wrapper enforces; MCP advises.

title: Hosted gate with a free daily allowance
text: api.reinkeep.xyz: 25 free checks a day per caller, with per-payer history for caps, duplicates and rate limits.

title: Signed receipts and pay-per-call
text: Receipts signed with a published key (EIP-712). After the free checks, $0.01 in USDG per call over x402, settled by the Priors facilitator.

title: Remote MCP and agent discovery
text: An MCP server at /mcp with 16 tools, plus llms.txt, an agent card and an OpenAPI file, so an agent can find the gate and call it on its own.

title: Token check, verdict, batch and share pages
text: Check a token in the browser, a free verdict API (60 a day), one payment against up to 10 tokens, and a page for every signed receipt. A status page shows what is up.

title: Pre-mortem for builders
text: Describe a launch and see the answer agents will get, the risks with fixes, and how similar launches did a day later. Nothing is stored.

title: Launch odds, board, radar and autopsy
text: From pools re-checked a day after launch. Shares appear only from 30 re-checked pools, and every answer says how much data is behind it.

title: AI second opinion on a REVIEW
text: Ask for it and a larger model gives its lean with the facts it rests on, signed in the receipt. Advice only: the decision stays with the rules.

title: Complete launch data
text: The collector misses most launches when it runs on Cloudflare. It is moving to a scheduled job that reads every launch from the chain. Odds, a launch board and autopsies wait for this.

title: Watch held tokens
text: After your agent buys, the gate re-reads the token every 30 minutes for 7 days and signs an exit, watch or hold signal, with an optional signed webhook. Costs 5 calls.

title: Token facts, kept fresh
text: Facts are read once today. Next: re-read them on a schedule, and look for powers under more names.

title: Holder price for the Reinkeep token
text: Holders pay half for paid checks. Built and switched off until the token launches. Paying in the token with a burn waits for the token itself.

title: Saved policies with wallet sign-in
text: Keep your rules and your history. Sign in by signing a message, no password.

title: More chains, after Robinhood Chain
text: The allowed chain and token are a setting, so the spend rules carry over. Token facts need fresh testing per chain.
